channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Florida Man Arrested in 2011 Ex-Fiancée Disappearance
item.description: A Florida man has been arrested on a murder charge in connection with the 2011 disappearance of his ex-fiancée. The arrest marks a significant development in the long-standing mystery. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: 911 Call Details Efforts to Save Hayden Panettiere's Life
item.description: A 911 call has revealed details of efforts made to save the life of Hayden Panettiere on the day she died. The call indicates that her boyfriend's brother attempted CPR. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Gymnastics Coach Sentenced to 90 Years for Filming Athletes
item.description: A former gymnastics coach has been sentenced to 90 years in prison for secretly filming young athletes. The coach recorded girls in a Mississippi gym's bathroom. The sentencing follows the discovery of the secret filming. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US DOJ Orders California to Review Voter Rolls
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) has ordered California to review its voter rolls for individuals who may be ineligible to vote, specifically noncitizens who received mail ballots. The DOJ has given California two days to conduct this… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A group of 72 retired US generals has urged the Pentagon to cancel the planned livestreaming of the execution of Nidal Hasan, stating it would "taint the honor of the military that employs it, and a nation that allows it." The Wall Street… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The ex-fiancé of U.S. Representative Nancy Mace and two other individuals have been charged with offenses related to sexual misconduct. These charges stem from sexual crimes that Representative Mace had previously detailed in a speech on… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: US Agency Rejects Automatic Body Camera Activation for ICE Officers
item.description: The U.S. agency responsible for immigration enforcement, ICE, has rejected a recommendation that its officers' body cameras be automatically activated. This decision means body cameras will not be set to turn on by default during their… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Three Reform UK councillors have resigned after being filmed making racist and extreme comments, including graphic threats of violence and misogynistic remarks. The undercover filming by ITV exposed these views, leading to a fresh crisis… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Pep Guardiola Faces Scrutiny Over Financial Dealings and Past Statements
item.description: Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola is facing scrutiny regarding his financial dealings and past statements. Reports highlight his significant net worth and past comments on the 115 charges brought against Manchester City. The coverage… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: Four individuals have been arrested in connection with the shooting of San Francisco 49ers player Keion White. The incident occurred at a Super Bowl party. Two people have been charged in the shooting, which reportedly involved rapper Lil… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Dolly Parton's nephew denies threatening estate, disputes restraining order
item.description: Dolly Parton's nephew has denied making threats to harm her estate and is pushing back against a restraining order filed against him by the estate. The specific nature of the alleged threats and the details of the restraining order were… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Friend testifies about phone request in Lamarre-Condon trial
item.description: A friend of Lamarre-Condon testified in court about a "concerning" mobile phone request, describing it as a "favour." The testimony was presented during the trial. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Victorian Public Servants Accused of Hiding $285m Covid Grant Losses
item.description: Senior public servants in Victoria, Australia, allegedly concealed losses of up to $285 million stemming from Covid-19 business grants awarded to ineligible businesses. Whistleblowers reportedly applauded the findings of an investigation… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Pedestrian Dies After Highway Collision; Investigation Ongoing
item.description: A pedestrian involved in a collision on Highway 12 has died. The number of fatalities in a separate crash on Highway 401 near London remains unclear as police continue their investigation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Five found dead near Michigan river trail, serial killer fears rise
item.description: Five people have been found dead near a river trail in Michigan. Authorities are hunting for a killer, and the deaths have sparked fears of a serial killer. The victims all lived along the walking trail. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Teen Arrested for School Shooting Threat Targeting Hindu Temple
item.description: A teenage boy has been arrested in connection with an alleged mass shooting plot that may have targeted an Aurora Hindu temple. The arrest followed a shooting threat made outside a London school, where the teen reportedly threatened… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: The United States has imposed sanctions on the horse racing and business network of the Mexican cartel known as the Cartel del Noreste (CDN). The Trump administration initiated a crackdown on money linked to the cartel within the horse… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Six killed in Wisconsin small plane crash; investigation launched
item.description: A small plane crashed in Wisconsin, killing all six people on board, including a child. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) have launched an investigation into the incident. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Eight US States Sue OpenAI Over ChatGPT Harms to Young Users
item.description: Eight US states have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, alleging that the artificial intelligence product exposes young users to dangerous behavior. The states claim the company's products are harming children en masse… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Alleged Hidden Recording Device
item.description: An engineer at OpenAI, identified as a Saudi national, was arrested at the company's San Francisco headquarters after a hidden recording device was allegedly discovered in an executive meeting room. The engineer's lawyer stated that the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Allegations of Gold Missing from Kashi Vishwanath Temple Gilded Dome
item.description: Allegations have surfaced that gold is missing from the gilded dome of the Kashi Vishwanath temple. A complaint regarding this matter has reportedly reached the Prime Minister's Office (PMO). Temple administration has responded to the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Scolds Election Commission Over Missing Counting Videos
item.description: The Supreme Court has criticized the Election Commission of India (ECI) for failing to provide a video recording related to vote counting. The court stated that "excuses will not work" and demanded to know the whereabouts of the recording… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala HC Quashes Case Against Teacher for Minor Classroom Correction
item.description: The Kerala High Court has quashed a criminal case filed against a teacher accused of pulling a student's hand as a form of classroom discipline. The court stated that trivial corrective measures taken by teachers to maintain discipline do… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Abhishek Banerjee questioned for six hours in billboard case
item.description: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee was questioned for over six hours by Kolkata Police on Wednesday regarding a Camac Street billboard. He arrived at the Shakespeare Sarani police station around 11:30 am and was interrogated by police… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Orders Railways to Insure Counter Tickets
item.description: The Supreme Court has directed Indian Railways to provide insurance cover to all tickets sold over the counter, similar to tickets purchased online. This directive is effective from October 27 onwards. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nandan Nilekani panel suggests AI for last-minute exam papers to curb leaks
item.description: A panel headed by Nandan Nilekani is exploring the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to generate question papers at the last minute as a potential solution to prevent exam leaks. The proposal aims to address the issue of paper leaks by… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Police Clash With Supporters of Imran Khan in Pakistan
item.description: Police clashed with supporters of former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan in northwestern Pakistan. During the confrontation, vehicles were set on fire. The events took place in what was described as Imran Khan's "last fortress." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Uttarakhand Govt Details Action in Ankita Bhandari Case
item.description: The Uttarakhand government has provided details of actions taken and assistance offered to the family in the Ankita Bhandari case. The government stated its sensitivity and strict action in the Ankita Bhandari case, outlining steps taken… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee summoned by Delhi court over 2019 case
item.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee has been summoned by a Saket court in Delhi in connection with a case from 2019. A hearing is scheduled for October 17. The court's order has reportedly increased Rathee's difficulties. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Three Indian students die in Germany building fire; one arrested
item.description: A fire in a residential building in Bochum, Germany, resulted in the deaths of three Indian students. Five people were injured in the incident. A 41-year-old Romanian national has been arrested on suspicion of murder. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Man Shot Dead Near Ulhasnagar Railway Station
item.description: A man was shot dead near Ulhasnagar Railway Station in Thane, Maharashtra. He was reportedly shot twice in the head. The attackers fled the scene and are currently being sought by authorities. Old rivalry is suspected as a motive. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Thugs defraud victims of lakhs in separate incidents
item.description: In Rajgarh, a fraudster posing as a wholesale mobile trader from Indore took a large order and disappeared with an advance payment of ₹5.89 lakh. Separately, in Indore, an hospital employee was defrauded of ₹1.22 lakh through cyber fraud… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Owaisi challenges SIR process in Supreme Court
item.description: Asaduddin Owaisi has filed a petition in the Supreme Court challenging the process of the State Election Commission (SEC) and alleging irregularities in its decision-making. The petition specifically targets the "SIR" process, though… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Woman's body found after four days at Chennai MRTS station
item.description: A woman died after falling through a gap at a Chennai MRTS station and her body was discovered four days later. She had reportedly entered a disused room in search of a toilet at the station. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Kills Lover in Nagpur, Burns Body Over Marriage Demand
item.description: A man allegedly killed his lover in Nagpur after she demanded marriage. The accused reportedly struck the woman on the head and then burned her body using a room heater. Following the incident, the accused fled to Jalgaon by train at night. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: OpenAI alleges ex-employee took trade secrets to Apple before court date
item.description: OpenAI has accused a former employee, who recently joined Apple, of taking over 100 files related to an unreleased product to a personal account. The allegation emerged hours before OpenAI and Apple were scheduled to face off in court over… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: DGCA restricts power bank carriage on flights after Indigo incident
item.description: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has prohibited the carriage of power banks on flights, following an incident involving an IndiGo aircraft. The decision aims to prevent potential dangers associated with power banks on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Criticizes Election Commission Over Lost Karnataka Vote Count Video
item.description: The Supreme Court has criticized the Election Commission of India (EC) for its inability to locate a video related to vote counting in the 2023 Karnataka elections. The court rejected what it termed "lame excuses" from the EC. The case… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Madras High Court Questions Tamil Nadu Govt on RSS March Ban
item.description: The Madras High Court questioned the Tamil Nadu government, led by Chief Minister Thalapathy Vijay, regarding its decision to deny permission for an RSS march. The court specifically asked why permission was granted for a similar march in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: Tensions have risen in Rajasthan following the death of a former BJP MLA and an alleged assault on an RSS worker inside a police station. Reports indicate the RSS worker was stripped and beaten. An MLA stated that a case of attempted… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
